### What to Take Before Drinking

- **A balanced meal:** Eating before you drink slows alcohol absorption and helps protect your stomach. Aim for a mix of protein, healthy fats, and fiber (such as eggs, whole grains, lean meat, or avocado).
- **Water or non-alcoholic fluids:** Drinking water beforehand helps you start hydrated before alcohol's diuretic effects kick in.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXjaGEOQjWCy-h6u37-mCoEOP8MZw8jqDJM7qoM3yL9xiRrJ-VCvmW7cAzbqt8dBMNOWdPzOsakjm47zEqMklZhP0-0MladYsdddr6sk7A7iG-StyO-BcGDc8O0XiS69mFdbYZF-Fe5CkOsno6awbZL9KxvQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF10id7qtX2yanFHaRUrZs3FLHV3CX7k8mCBELc_BVXtfz4D1ZxEjy8xEsh30_2MEQoUVD3RVYtaXSf1ty_HaJdnFssW5sZilmlDIsvtsvyHQBQ2sCRUwNhOEn_kieZOrRwxZApBN3deecJaRQ-lHNzEp36MTd1YvGw8IRtRXsH-JGlg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsQEBxCJF16Dqdu7DWGN1J_tDHH1Cg6_7xEhJ22KPHEf0Whpzb5locIZfsnZ34dQtsd6OfDo2HmcS3oSS7pGd4OARsEE6G7ZCCPm57xDWzATlUNqSGy5zddSj1qcVZ0ztmVnk-qDD0SVWuTgdZMZBX8x7v6I2LqRvBcCn9JjROO5RHNrEwpXxdiDWLV9u04N1udAcdbDSKga4QcpDRpWOXmLpHPoWTeRlVWbivUloDg7PoEo)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX22V3moLstssXnaxcK6i9rHrKMQFm6NA0taw9YN2DCQl3ehXuV0BJiLpNCH9ohBUnTPZ0RROnqgPkuRlzT8IqapndVNEocqW8uAPpmBpgzRxCnqSVDLwTo4HeipTYYSHFWkTadT4I)
